objective: Replace Soft Target with Timing/Pressure v2 while preserving System authority, quest lifecycle, earned progress, history and rollback.

roles_before.artifact: Neon system_events owns derived RPG state.
Quest v2 lifecycle and one-active-quest invariant.

role_dispositions.destination: New deadlines require HARD_EXTERNAL or CHALLENGE semantics.
Legacy soft-target events remain readable; new actions use Timing/Pressure v2.
Recorded base SHA and Git history.

capability_probes.assertion: A real hard deadline still expires a quest.
A recommended window cannot expire/fail a quest or remove reward.
An explicitly accepted Challenge Contract can expire and create exactly one predeclared recovery quest.
Pre-change behavior remains recoverable from the base SHA.

tests.expected: PASS timing and challenge regression tests.

tests.command: python3 tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python3 tests/system_controller_routing_guard.py && python3 tests/lifeup_system_guard.py && python3 tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py

known_intentional_losses: Soft Target is retired for new player-facing actions; legacy records remain readable.
